prs.body:
## High Level Overview of Change

This PR adds `sfPreviousTxnID`/`sfPreviousTxnLgrSequence` as fields to all ledger objects that don't already have them (except `LedgerHashes`, because that seems a bit redundant and also those objects aren't modified via transaction).

The affected objects are:
* `DirectoryNode`
* `Amendments`
* `FeeSettings`
* `NegativeUNL`
* `AMM`

### Context of Change

It makes it a lot easier to go through the history of a ledger object. Related to #4602.

### Type of Change

- [x] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [x] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [x] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)



## Test Plan
Tests have been added to ensure that everything behaves as-is prior to the amendment and transitions seamlessly when the amendment is activated.

prs.title: Remove support for deprecated PreviousTxnID field (RIPD-710):
prs.author: nbougalis

comments.author: nbougalis
comments.body:
For discussion:

Transactions submitted with this will fail by giving an error of type `tefINTERNAL` and an message of `Exception occurred during transaction`:

```
{
   "result" : {
      "error" : "internal",
      "error_code" : 59,
      "error_message" : "Exception occurred during transaction",
      "request" : {
         "command" : "submit",
         "secret" : "masterpassphrase",
         "tx_json" : {
            "Account" : "rHb9CJAWyB4rj91VRWn96DkukG4bwdtyTh",
            "Amount" : "200000000",
            "Destination" : "r3kmLJN5D28dHuH8vZNUZpMC43pEHpaocV",
            "PreviousTxnID" : "C84F85D005B5EE428BD059906470BF7EF52ADE60EF862385C7BB273EF816A76A",
            "TransactionType" : "Payment"
         }
      },
      "status" : "error"
   }
}
```

We can't easily change this behavior (it comes from deep down in the call stack, via the `STTx` constructor throwing because `STObject::setType` returns `false`) - at least not without carefully considering the implications. 

Possible solutions are:
- Leave `sfPreviousTxnID` defined as `SOE_OPTIONAL` and have an explicit check for it in `Transactor::preCheck` - if it's present, return a tailored error and stop processing.
- Add `SOE_DEPRECATED` to `SOE_Flags` and appropriately mark `sfPreviousTxnID`. When parsing a transaction, allow `SOE_DEPRECATED` fields to be specified and add special code in the `Transactor` to generate sensible error messages if such fields are present (e.g. "The 'XYZ' field is deprecated.") 
- Do nothing: just let the transaction fail without explaning.

comments.author: JoelKatz
comments.body:
The failure comes from the transaction not matching the template. The fix
would be to catch that failure when we do the check and report it
appropriately. I believe the failure comes from setType. A bit of a fix
would be to at least report that setType failed. A better fix would be for
setType to throw an exception describing the mismatch and catch it in the
RPC call so we can provide a customized error response.

Tampering with the transaction processing code and transaction templates
just to support some RPC feature is basically a non-starter. That code
should be treated as sacred and not modified for client convenience.

DS

prs.body:
The PreviousTxnID field has been deprecated and should not be used for
transactions that use the field will now be rejected.

The AccountTxnID feature should be used instead by enabling transaction
tracking and specifying a transaction ID at submission. More details
are available at: https://ripple.com/build/transactions/#accounttxnid

Reviews: @JoelKatz, @rec
